title: A write waiting for the site's write lease leaves the site's queue, so the conversation holding the lease keeps writing
steps: S1: Through the shipped bundle (handler.test.mjs), conversation A holds the Joomla site's write lease; conversation B's write is refused SITE_BUSY and waits; A then writes again.
S2: With the real createCallMemory and waitOutLease (call-memory.test.mjs), B waits for the lease inside a flight while A's read is queued on the same site.
expect: S1: A's write is answered while B is still waiting; B sends again only after A's call.
S2: A's read answers before B's wait ends, and B's next send is queued behind it.

selectors.code: call-memory.mjs flight/flightSeat, lease-wait.mjs waitOutLease leave/rejoin, index.ts applyDoor

evidence: Review 19/10/2026: a script with the real createCallMemory + waitOutLease showed A's read answered only after B's whole lease wait (up to 100 s); A's lease then lapsed and B wrote mid-request
fence: A lease wait is spent outside the site's flight

tests: 🔒 C1: on Joomla the conversation holding the lease writes while another waits for it — the waiter is out of the site flight
🔒 C1: the conversation holding the lease is not queued behind the write waiting for it, and the waiter queues again behind it
